title: KK Viimsi win U19 League!
description: KK Viimsi have won U19 League in Estonia. They overcame Tartu Ulikool/Metec 87-84 in the Final game. Kristo Rannaste (191-SF-2007) stepped up with 25 points and 15 rebounds, whilst Christian Kask (187-G-2008) netted 21. Holger Suurorg (179-PG-2007) scored 16 points and Robin Berol) delivered 10 points for the winners. Vladyslav Sinnik (203-C-2007) replied with 23 points in the losing effort.
imageCaption: KK Viimsi win U19 League! (Photo: basket.ee)

title: SK Nord/Cramo earn U18 League title
description: SK Nord/Cramo are U18 League champions. They outgunned Rapla Korvpallikool 58-44 in the Final today. Simm-Marten Saadi (205-F-2005) came up with 24 points to lead the winners. Rapla held their opponents to just 7 points in the second frame to take a 27-24 halftime lead. But SK Nord/Cramo replied with a 22-5 rally in the third term to surge ahead for good. Mikk Savi (183-F-2006) accounted for 12 points for the champions. Karmo Kilk (195-G/F-2005) replied with 14 points for Rapla.
imageCaption: SK Nord/Cramo earn U18 League title (Photo:basket.ee)

title: Audentes SK/Tallinna Ulikool/TSK celebrate U18 title
description: Audentes SK/Tallinna Ulikool/TSK celebrated U18 title in the country. In the Final game they edged SK Nord Aid/Cramo 76-61. Oliver Mets (2004) stepped up with 14 points and Andre Rasmus (188-G-2004) scored 13. Patrick Malm (194-G-2004) and Gerrit Lehe (197-G-2005) ended up with 11 points each in a win. Sander Jarve (198-F-2004) replied with 16 points in a loss. Simm-Marten Saadi (203-F-2005) produced 15 and Gregor Allik (190-G-2004) had 13.
imageCaption: Audentes SK/Tallinna Ulikool/TSK celebrate U18 title (Photo: basket.ee)
